resources.name: Planner
resources.description: Creates concrete, ordered implementation plans for requested changes.

resources.name: Debugger
resources.description: Investigates failures systematically to identify root causes and minimal verified fixes.

resources.name: Reviewer
resources.description: Reviews implemented changes for correctness, regressions, risks, and missing validation.

resources.name: OneShot
resources.description: Implements one narrow, clearly defined change end to end with minimal scope and proportionate validation.

resources.name: Deep Think
resources.description: Analyzes complex decisions using evidence, explicit constraints, alternatives, risks, and validation criteria.

resources.name: Challenge Plan
resources.description: Challenges a plan or idea with targeted questions to resolve material decisions, assumptions, and trade-offs before execution.

resources.name: Commit
resources.description: Creates a focused local Git commit containing only the intended changes after inspecting, validating, and staging them safely.
